title: The surge.t1 tail (post-window ticks 3000–4000) carries no trace of the claimed persistent crisis — the 170000ms capture's 'banner persists' state is unverifiable from the manifest
detail: Per-tick hashes cannot show whether a crisis stayed active past the window end or resolved — the demo's post-window claim rides on unannotated hash rows. The capture tick (3400 = 170000ms) has no marker tying it to the manifest.
recommended_fix: Annotate the manifest (or a sidecar) with the event lifecycle ticks — trigger, any resolve, and the capture ticks 600/1300/3400 — so the post-window persistence claim is auditable.
